finding.title: A disabled button still submits its form
finding.explanation: The button now sets `aria-disabled` instead of `disabled`, and drops only its own onClick. A button inside a form still submits it, on a click and on Enter, because the browser only skips submission for a truly disabled button.
finding.reasoningSummary: Form.tsx renders children inside a <form>, and Button's default type is submit. aria-disabled has no effect on form submission.
finding.suggestedFix: Keep the native attribute alongside the ARIA one: disabled={disabled} aria-disabled={disabled}.
